answer: The opal ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own ivory record, and its own share of the glacier quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 905 identities would post 2354 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
